How many employees does Typeface have?
Typeface, Inc. has approximately 301 total employees worldwide as of June 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data. Typeface’s total headcount has grown 178.5% from 108 employees in 2023 to 301 in 2026.
Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026
Is Typeface hiring right now?
Yes, Typeface is actively hiring. Typeface had 24 active job postings in 2026, a 11.8% decline from 2025 — see job openings & hiring trends.
About Typeface’s Workforce
Typeface, Inc. is an Information Technology Services company that employs 301 people worldwide as of June 2026. It is the 8th-largest by headcount among its peers. Founded in 2022, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.
Typeface's workforce has grown 178.5% from 2023 to 2026, up 9.1% year over year in 2026. Its workforce is concentrated most in South Asia (52.5%), followed by North America (42.1%) and Northern Europe (1.1%).
Typeface's functional groups are Engineering (47.1%), Sales and Marketing (27.4%), and Finance and Operations (25.5%), with Sales and Marketing growing fastest (up 20.5%). The average salary is $101,052, ranging from a median of $169,000 in North America to $40,000 in South Asia, up 0.5% year over year in 2026.
Typeface's active job postings fell 11.8% in 2026 to 24, with new postings per month cooling from 15 in 2023 to 9 in 2026. Overall employee sentiment is negative and declining.
